scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I submitted an application to refinance my home with a conventional loan for $125,000 over 360 months. Could you please tell me the current status or outcome of my application?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your application for a conventional refinancing loan in the amount of $125,000 over 360 months was not approved. The main reason for the denial was your debt-to-income ratio. If you have further questions about the details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Oh, that’s disappointing news. Could you explain what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application? Also, are there any other reasons listed for the denial, or was that the only one?
dialogue.agent: I understand this is disappointing. The debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is the percentage of your monthly debt payments compared to your monthly income. Lenders use this ratio to assess your ability to manage monthly payments and repay the loan. For your application, the only reason listed for denial was your debt-to-income ratio. No other reasons were recorded.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for explaining. I appreciate your clear answer.

Just to confirm, since my application was denied, do any high-cost or negative amortization flags apply to it, or is that not relevant in my situation? Also, has my loan application or information been transferred or sold to another institution, or does that only happen with approved loans?
dialogue.agent: Those fields are not applicable in your situation because your application was denied. High-cost loan status, negative amortization features, and loan transfers or sales only apply to approved and originated loans. Your loan application has not been transferred or sold to any other institution.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for clarifying all of that. I understand my application was denied due to my debt-to-income ratio, and no other reasons or loan features apply in my case. I appreciate you responding to my questions promptly and clearly.

<Neutral> – I’m giving a neutral rating because the denial was disappointing, but you provided clear information and answered my questions directly. Thank you for your help.
